summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd (issuer) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor to sell 12,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.207 per share for an aggregate amount not stated (approx. $2.484M). The transaction, expected to close Q2 2026, relies on a Section 4(2) private placement exemption and is subject to customary closing conditions, including Nasdaq regulatory approval. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a direct share issuance (PIPE-like) rather than a special situation, so it does not fall under any special-situations category. Watch for completion risk and Nasdaq listing compliance.
